**Harry Potter novels – first‑edition publication dates**

| # | Title (UK edition) | UK (original) publication date | US (first‑edition) publication date* |
|---|--------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| 1 | *Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone* | 26 June 1997 (Bloomsbury) | 1 September 1998 (Scholastic) |
| 2 | *Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets* | 2 July 1998 (Bloomsbury) | 2 June 1999 (Scholastic) |
| 3 | *Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban* | 8 July 1999 (Bloomsbury) | 8 September 1999 (Scholastic) |
| 4 | *Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire* | 8 July 2000 (Bloomsbury) | 8 July 2000 (Scholastic) – simultaneous release |
| 5 | *Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix* | 21 June 2003 (Bloomsbury) | 21 June 2003 (Scholastic) – simultaneous worldwide release |
| 6 | *Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince* | 16 July 2005 (Bloomsbury) | 16 July 2005 (Scholastic) – simultaneous worldwide release |
| 7 | *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows* | 21 July 2007 (Bloomsbury) | 21 July 2007 (Scholastic) – simultaneous worldwide release |

\*The US dates are for the first U.S. hard‑cover editions published by **Scholastic** (the American counterpart to Bloomsbury).  

### Sources  

* **Philosopher’s Stone** – UK release date shown in the book’s infobox table【.../fragment (line with “United Kingdom | 26 June 1997”)】. The US Scholastic release (1 Sept 1998) is the well‑documented first‑edition date for the *Sorcerer’s Stone* (the title under which the book was released in the United States).  
* **Chamber of Secrets** – “originally published in the UK on 2 July 1998 and later, in the US on 2 June 1999”【.../fragment (line with Chamber of Secrets)】.  
* **Prisoner of Azkaban** – “published … in the UK on 8 July 1999 and in the US on 8 September 1999”【.../fragment (line with Prisoner of Azkaban)】.  
* **Goblet of Fire** – “published on 8 July 2000 at the same time by Bloomsbury and Scholastic”【.../fragment (line with Goblet of Fire)】.  
* **Order of the Phoenix** – “published worldwide in English on 21 June 2003”【.../fragment (line with Order of the Phoenix)】.  
* **Half‑Blood Prince** – “published on 16 July 2005”【.../fragment (line with Half‑Blood Prince)】.  
* **Deathly Hallows** – “published on 21 July 2007”【.../fragment (line with Deathly Hallows)】.  

These dates refer to the **first hard‑cover editions** that launched the series in each market. Subsequent paperback, illustrated and special‑edition releases have their own later dates.
